## A bigger year for the festival

The summer festival drew 42,000 visitors this year, up from 28,000 in 2019 — its strongest turnout since it began.

Music was the biggest draw, accounting for 19,000 visitors, ahead of food stalls at 12,000, crafts at 7,000 and the children's area at 4,000.

Organisers thanked the 300 volunteers who made it possible.
